notes: Scope delivered in full: experience (orbs with frozen merge/pickup radii and lifetime, level curve levelFromTotalXp plus reverse lookup, gains from ore breaking, mob kills, smelting and breeding, xp.changed event), enchanting (deterministic three-slot offers from seed/bookshelves/slot with enchantLevelCost, lapisPerSlot costs, max levels and the Fortune-vs-SilkTouch conflict, effects wired into break time, drops, durability, melee/arrow damage and damage reduction), farming (hoe tilling of dirt/grass, hydration inside radius 4, eight-stage random-tick growth with minLight 9, trampling, seed and produce drops) and breeding (love mode via BREED_FOOD inside partner radius 8, baby with scale 0.5 and speed factor 1.15, growth at 24000 ticks, parent cooldown 6000 ticks, xpOnBreed 4).

All frozen v1.1.0 contract values were consumed from packages/core-types and never redefined or edited. New items stay inside the ITEM_V2 band 305-322 and the five new recipes go through the existing recipe registry via createV2RecipeRegistry; v1 ITEM_DEFS, ITEM_DEF_COUNT, BLOCK_DEF_COUNT and the default registries are untouched so the existing count assertions still hold.

Determinism: offers, crop growth rolls, fortune rolls and baby ids all derive from the frozen hash helpers (hashU32/hash01) with no Math.random, Date.now or wall clock. Determinism tests were kept and never cut.

Cross-package boundaries respected: nothing outside packages/gameplay was modified. Entity movement and AI stay in the sim package; breeding exposes Animal/Herd state plus scaleOf and speedFactorOf instead of reaching into it, and farming/enchanting declare small local FarmWorld/EnchantWorld interfaces.

Barrel integration is L1-G only. Two genuine name clashes surfaced when re-exporting the new folders from packages/gameplay/src/index.ts and were resolved there: isReplaceable (redstone keeps the plain name, farming is exposed as isFarmReplaceable) and fortuneBonus (enchanting keeps the plain name, farming is exposed as cropFortuneBonus).

Work split across three L2 children, each restricted to its own folder: enchanting; farming and crops; breeding plus the v2 item defs and recipes. L1-G implemented the whole experience module itself and performed every git and integration step; children ran no git commands and created no environments.

gha mcp observations for the tracker: (1) write_file does not honour the sticky execute cwd, so a relative path resolved against the env work root while still returning ok/created true - absolute paths are required; (2) re-running an identical gate command string returns the previous job with deduped true unless allow_duplicate is set, which can silently hide a fresh result; (3) three parallel Notion spawnSession calls in one turn had two rejected as invalid while the first succeeded, so children had to be spawned one per turn.
Nothing from the cut list was dropped: all listed enchantment effects, all three crops and the full breeding polish are implemented.
